segments.zh: 本輪分析涵蓋 ZW-DMA04 區的全部測點數據，時間範圍為 2025-06-08 至 2025-12-21。
segments.en: This round of analysis covers all monitoring point data in Zone ZW-DMA04, from 2025-06-08 to 2025-12-21.

segments.zh: 區內共有壓力測點 12 個、流量測點 4 個，數據完整率為 96.3%。
segments.en: The zone contains 12 pressure monitoring points and 4 flow monitoring points, with a data completeness rate of 96.3%.

segments.zh: 漏損定位採用夜間最小流量法，輔以相關性分析。
segments.en: Leak localisation adopts the minimum night flow method, supplemented by correlation analysis.

segments.zh: 本輪共記錄設備問題報警 37 條，其中壓力傳感器故障 21 條。
segments.en: A total of 37 equipment alarms were recorded this round, including 21 pressure sensor faults.

segments.zh: 報得準不準，直接影響後續定位計算。
segments.en: Whether the alarms are reported accurately directly affects the subsequent localisation computation.

segments.zh: 可用記錄 26 條，其中 4 條為人工補錄。
segments.en: There are 26 usable records, of which 4 are manually backfilled entries.

segments.zh: 壓力測點 P-07 的數據在 7-18 後歸零，判斷為設備故障。
segments.en: The data of pressure monitoring point P-07 returned to zero after 18 July, judged as an equipment fault.

segments.zh: 模型率定通過不代表輸出模型持續準確。
segments.en: Passing model calibration means the exported model stays accurate.

errors.note: 原文为「不代表」（does not mean）

segments.zh: 方案三的模擬值與實測值擬合最優。
segments.en: Option C shows the best fit between simulated and measured values.

segments.zh: 在本輪條件下兩者未同時成立，需進一步分析。
segments.en: The two do not hold simultaneously, and further analysis is required.

errors.note: 丢了前提 under the conditions of this round

segments.zh: 驗證結論表明模型精度滿足工程應用要求。
segments.en: The verification conclusion indicates that the model accuracy meets engineering application requirements.

segments.zh: 本輪分析共定位漏損點 5 處，完成修復 3 處。
segments.en: This round of analysis localised 5 leak points and completed 3 repairs.

segments.zh: 建議優先採用方案三的率定參數。
segments.en: We recommend adopting the calibration parameters of Option C as a priority.

segments.zh: 後續工作按計劃推進，重點關注剩餘 2 處漏損點。
segments.en: Subsequent work will proceed as planned, with a focus on the remaining 2 leak points.

segments.zh: 流量信號整體平穩，未發現異常波動。
segments.en: The flow signals are generally stable, and no abnormal fluctuations were found.

segments.zh: 率定後模型滿足驗收標準，可投入使用。
segments.en: The calibrated model meets the acceptance criteria and is ready for use.
